definition: Total population of the reporting country or economy
notes: Do not substitute households or resident population under a different definition

variable_name: GDP per capita current US dollars
definition: Gross domestic product divided by population at current US dollar values
known_confounders: exchange rates price levels population revisions
notes: Nominal monetary measure not a welfare measure

definition: Expected years a newborn would live under prevailing age-specific mortality rates

notes: Do not interpret as individual lifespan or a direct healthcare quality score
